title: Product Liability Action
description: Definition of Product Liability Action under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: a complaint filed by a person before a District Commission or State Commission or National Commission, as the case may be, for claiming compensation for the harm caused to him
content.plain_language: a legal complaint filed to claim compensation for harm caused by a product
examples: A consumer files a complaint against a manufacturer for a defective phone that caused them injury
A person sues a company for selling a harmful product that resulted in financial loss
non_examples: A customer complaining about poor customer service
A business disputing a contract with a supplier

user_queries: How to file a product liability complaint?
